tei:div.tei:p: 15) mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mchod spros med rgyun khyer bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i dbus: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i dkyil du: bsod nams tshogs chen bsog pa'i thabs: rgyun khyer zab mo 'dir ru bkod: sa ma ya: thabs shes rdzas dang ci 'byor gyi: longs spyod zas sna la sogs bsags: ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud rtsir brlabs: thod rnga'i sgra dang dbyangs snyan pos: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ tshogs snod ye shes ka pā lar: tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: kun bzang 'dod yon bla na med: rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs khengs gyur: badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings skye med pho brang nas: rig stong bsam brjod bral ba yi: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha: gnas 'dir tshogs la gshegs su gsol: dam tshig chen po'i gdan la bzhugs: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos yid ting 'dzin dag pa yi: thabs shes tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bde stong klong yangs ngang du bzhes: lta ba mtha' bral chen por bskang: sgom pa ma bcos gnyug mar bskang: spyod pa bya rtsol bral bar bskang: 'bras bu ye 16)grol chen por bskang: nyams chags chos nyid dbyings su bshags: bdag snang gnyis 'dzin ru tra bkug: bdag med shes rab mtshon gyis bsgral: rang byung ye shes klong du bstabs: kha raṃ khā hi: thabs shes rdzas mchog bla med rdzas: tshims pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la la ho: dpal chen spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i: lhag skyong pho mo lhag la rol: ushtsi ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba'i mthus: rang byung ye shes mngon gyur nas: mi gnas gtan srid zin par shog: de ltar rgyun du brtson gyur na: nyams chags ma lus kun byang nas: tshe 'dir rkyen zhi tshogs gnyis rdzogs: phyi ma dpal ri mkha' 'gro'i grong: bgrod 'gyur 'di la the tshom med:

sa ma ya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do: brda thim: : zhes pa'ang rnal 'byor shī la badzra gyis bskul lcag zab phyir mi ldog tsam du dus mtha'i gter gzugs 'chang ba padma sgrol dkar ram/ bde ba'i rdo rjes klong brda 'phrul yig las zhal bshus pa'o// dge'o//
